args.summary:
Model built and verified successfully for the 30+40+30 m cast-in-place prestressed concrete continuous box-girder bridge (deck width 12.5 m, single-cell box, C50).

Structural idealization: 2D spine-beam, elastic beam-column element (MR-01); system "continuous_on_piers" because both support piers have twin circular columns given (MR-05). Girder section integrated from the cast_box outline: A = 6.532 m², I = 3.564 m⁴ (MR-02); Ec = 34500 MPa (C50, JTG 3362-2018 3.1.5); γ = 26.0 kN/m³ (JTG D60-2015 4.2.1), w = 169.832 kN/m, m = 17.312 t/m (MR-07, girder self-weight only).

Supports (2 bearings per line, MR-04): abutments 0 and 3 and Pier 1 use PTFE sliding laminated elastomeric bearings (longitudinal free, Kh=0), Pier 2 uses a fixed plain laminated elastomeric bearing (longitudinal spring, Kh = 13091 kN/m). Laminated bearings modeled as zero-length springs (MR-03) with manufacturer Ge = 1.2 MPa (MR-00 override); shape factors S = 10.10 / 13.54 / 14.69 / 10.10 and vertical stiffnesses Kv = 3.61e6 / 8.08e6 / 8.97e6 / 3.61e6 kN/m (JTG 3362-2018 8.7). Piers modeled as elastic beam-columns fixed at base with twin columns merged (A = 4.021 m², I = 0.6434 m⁴, Ec = 32500 MPa; Pier 1 H = 14 m, Pier 2 H = 8 m; MR-06).

Live load: Highway Class I, one-way, 3 design lanes (W = 11.5 m), ξ = 0.78, qk = 10.5 kN/m, Pk = 320/340/320 kN for the 30/40/30 m spans (JTG D60-2015 4.3.1).

Results: fundamental vertical frequency f1 = 3.434 Hz → impact factor μ = 0.2023 (JTG D60-2015 4.3.2). Self-weight support reactions 1840 / 6646 / 6666 / 1832 kN; self-weight mid-span moments 8490 / 12616 / 8372 kNm and support moments −21233 / −21469 kNm. Governing lane moment: max positive 9701 kNm (mid-span 2), max negative −7558 kNm. All L1/L2/L3 checks passed.
